organization_note: MiniMax Group Inc., a holding company incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, has its headquarters in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Its subsidiaries Shanghai Xiyu Jizhi Technology and Beijing Xiyu Jizhi Technology develop the foundation models, and Shanghai Xiyu Technology and Nanonoble Pte. Ltd. of Singapore operate the open platform; Nanonoble also contracts for the chat.minimax.io and minimax.io/audio services. One name, MiniMax, covers the models and the platform.
